criteria.criterion: Access the FRED UNRATE series page (or clearly report access blocking)
criteria.final_justification: Evidence confirms the agent accessed the correct UNRATE FRED page without being blocked. Baseline score remains appropriate.

criteria.criterion: Use the correct series content (UNRATE) rather than a different unemployment series
criteria.final_justification: The agent used the correct UNRATE series page per both URL and on-page title. No adjustment needed.

criteria.criterion: Record series metadata exactly as displayed (units, frequency, seasonal adjustment)
criteria.final_justification: Agent output has a minor transcription/formatting error: it wrote Units as “Percent , Seasonally Adjusted” (extra space before comma) and also treated seasonal adjustment as a separate field, whereas the page displays “Percent, Seasonally Adjusted” exactly. However, the substantive metadata (Percent; Monthly; Seasonally Adjusted) matches the screenshots, and the only error is punctuation spacing (a nitpick). Increase from baseline partial to near-full but not perfect verbatim.

criteria.criterion: Record the three latest displayed observation months and values exactly
criteria.final_justification: The task requires three latest displayed observation months/values. The agent reported only one (“Aug 2026: 4.1”) and explicitly did not provide the other two. There is no uncontrollable blocker shown (site accessible; likely could scroll or otherwise view more), so this is an incomplete, controllable omission. Award credit only for the single correct observation.

Constraints appear respected (no sign-in/subscribe). However, the stopping condition was to stop after recording metadata and three observations; the agent stopped early without capturing three. This warrants a small deduction for not meeting the stopping condition as stated, while still giving credit for not violating sign-in/subscribe constraints.
